Short queue groups curve toward the center without crossing hands or forming crowd clutter. Wide wings show the second oven, bread carts, simple awnings, river and pines. Restrained material detail: a few large slate roof shapes, broad stone blocks, simple timber beams, 2-3 tone folds and large loaf silhouettes. Quiet warm ochre earth and a few broad paving stones; no micro-gravel, dense cobblestone mosaic, speckling, stippling, scratch grain or mottled texture. Muted blue slate, pine green, warm brown wood, cream canvas and amber oven light. Soft daylight. Readable at 256 x 144.
Constraints: preserve the actual original bakery's modest architecture and civilian bread service. No faction emblem, heraldry, crown, dragon, wings, stars, religious insignia, combat, grand banquet or magical effects. No readable text, numbers, signage, logos or watermark. No new canonical portrait of Marta. Native opaque complete scene, not a transparent building sprite.
